CEI 2026 : IEEE 2026 6th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology

Link: https://ais.cn/u/Mvqeuu
 
When Nov 20, 2026 - Nov 22, 2026
Where Nanning, China
Submission Deadline Sep 24, 2026
Final Version Due Oct 21, 2026
Categories    computer science   electronics   control   communications
 

Call For Papers

IEEE 2026 6th International Conference on Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering and Intelligent Control Technology (CEI 2026) will take place during November 20-22, 2026 in Nanning, China.

𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗯𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗲: https://ais.cn/u/Mvqeuu

---𝗖𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗽𝗮𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀---
The topics of interest for submission include, but are not limited to:
◕ Computer Science
◔ Computer Science and Computer Engineering
◔ Artificial Intelligence and Neural Network
◔ Machine Learning and Deep Learning
◔ Natural Language Processing and Understanding
◔ Intelligent Algorithm Design and Optimization
◔ Automation Software Engineering
◔ Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
◔ Computer Network and Information Security
◔ Information System Design and Application
◔ Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery

◕ Electronic Information Engineering
◔ Wireless Communication Technology and System
◔ Communication Signal Processing and Optimization
◔ Radar Detection and Signal Processing
◔ Microwave Circuit Design and Application
◔ Antenna Design and Electromagnetic Compatibility
◔ Electromagnetic Field Analysis and Calculation
◔ Single-Chip Microcomputer and Embedded System
◔ Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Technology
◔ Electronic System Integration and Testing
◔ Optoelectronic Technology and Application

◕ Intelligent Control Technology
◔ Intelligent Control Theory and Algorithm
◔ Automatic Control System Design
◔ Fuzzy Control and Neural Network Control
◔ Power System Intelligent Control
◔ Industrial Control System and Automation
◔ Motion Control and Servo System
◔ Process Control and Intelligent Regulation
◔ Human-Machine Collaborative Control
◔ Complex System Control and Optimization
◔ Robotic Control and Automation

---𝗣𝘂𝗯𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻---
All papers, both invited and contributed, will be reviewed by two or three expert reviewers from the conference committees. After a careful reviewing process, all accepted papers of CEI 2026 will be published in IEEE (ISBN: 979-8-3195-4797-2) and will be submitted to EI Compendex, Scopus for indexing.

---𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀---
Full Paper Submission Date: September 24, 2026
Notification of Acceptance Date: October 5, 2026
Final Paper Submission Date: October 21, 2026
Registration Deadline: November 5, 2026
Conference Dates: November 20-22, 2026

---𝗣𝗮𝗽𝗲𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗯𝗺𝗶𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻---
Please send the full paper(word+pdf) to Submission System:
